d:
Rajasthan ke kalbeliya samuday men mahilaon ki pahchan mukhy rup se unke paranprik nrity se juri rahi hai. lekin mamta sapera ne is paranpra se aage barhkar morchang, khartal jaise vadyayantr bajana sikha. sangit ke prati unka junun unhen ek alag pahchan dila raha hai. mamta sapera ke lie sangit sirf kala nahin, balki apni pahchan banane ka zariya bhi hai.
